text: Since 88562f1, change verifiers cite Athena's recorded fmt, clippy and test results instead of rerunning them, but D43 (crates/athena-core/src/verify.rs, around line 335) still marks a behavior criterion unmet unless its evidence cites a command the verifier was seen running, so job 20261024-033933-ta60 was rejected on 'cargo test passes for the workspace' while Athena's own recorded test run on the same candidate passed. Count a command as run when Athena itself ran and recorded it on the same candidate tree and it passed (the checks shown under 'Checks Athena ran on this tree'), so citing it satisfies D43; a recorded check that failed, or one recorded for a different tree, still does not. Test both cases and update D43's documentation.
